name: arXiv:2406.08155 QuantMoE-Bench: Examining Post-Training Quantization for Mixture-of-Experts
notes: The shared-vs-token-conditioned expert precision finding: because shared experts are accessed by ALL tokens while token-conditioned experts are selectively activated, shared experts potentially need HIGHER precision. Also frames why a single fixed precision for the whole MoE is suboptimal.
